title: openai /v1/chat.completions parity: roles, stop/logprobs, streaming, tool-calls, structured output
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: OpenAI /v1/chat.completions parity updates: roles param handling, stop sequences and logprobs exposure, streaming stability improvements, richer function/tool-calling semantics, and structured output formatting fixes.
description: Motivation: complete parity with OpenAI's /v1/chat.completions for our OpenAI-compatibility layer. This PR implements consistent handling of roles in chat messages, deterministic stop sequence behavior combined with logprobs exposure, more robust streaming path to avoid truncated tool/function calls, and final formatting for structured output (JSON/text) to match OpenAI's responses. Changes include runtime hooks for streaming chunk ordering, new API translation layer for function/tool calling parameters, adjustments to stop-token handling to preserve logprob annotations, improved validation and docs, and test coverage for edge-cases seen in customer workloads. Checklist: [x] roles preserved in request and response, [x] stop sequence semantics implemented with logprobs, [x] streaming stability tests and fixes applied, [x] function/tool-calling semantics and structured output formatting added, [x] integration tests and SDK compat patches included, [x] docs updated. Notes: this touches the streaming runtime and the compatibility layer; we introduced a compatibility shim to avoid behavioral changes for existing Redwood API consumers. See linked Linear items for behavioral compatibility tests and rollout plan.

Jen O'Neil: CI flaked on linting in the TS SDK; can you address the formatter?

ci_details: Initial run: failed (typescript lint). Reran: pass. CI matrix: unit tests (linux, mac) passed; e2e parity tests passed against local model harness; integration job against dedicated staging showed no regressions. Coverage drop: -0.3% in runtime package (expected due to refactor).
post_merge_notes: Feature gated behind openai_compat_v2 flag. Rollout plan: enable for 10% internal test traffic for 48h, then 100% in staging for 24h before broad rollout. Monitor: streaming error rate, tool-call truncation alerts, chat-completions latency p95. Backout: revert compatibility flag to v1 behavior.
testing_summary: New unit tests for role normalization, stop/logprobs edge cases, and streaming chunk reassembly added. E2E tests run against local LLM harness covering function calling with multi-chunk tool payloads and structured JSON outputs. Observed 0.02% message reorder failures on first run, fixed by adding chunk sequence markers.
notes_for_ops: Deploy requires a runtime config flag (openai_compat_v2=true) and a small schema migration for chat_schema to accept optional logprobs metadata. No DB migrations. Recommend rolling to a single region first and monitoring the new metric openai_compat.parity_errors.
